childDimensionRequirements.rationale: The Eurostat generation account does not describe what happens after waste generation; each destination stage requires separate Danish evidence.
The mixed-food-basket total must be disaggregated by commodity family before commodity-specific circularity conclusions are possible.
The API payload supplies values but this intake does not yet carry Denmark's sampling frame, estimation details or quantified uncertainty.
Commodity children require source-faithful units and periods; they must not be inferred as homogeneous calendar-year tonne observations from the aggregate table.
The mixed litres/tonnes inputs, grain-season timing and 20-tonne contradiction require explicit reconciliation before component reuse.
ÅSUB category 09.1 combines animal and mixed food waste; child quantities must separate those scopes and identify edible versus inedible material where the source permits.
The R3+ input amount does not state the mass reaching each downstream recovery, nutrient-return, energy or disposal destination.
A realized resource-circularity outcome needs recovered-output and use evidence; the operation-class label alone is insufficient.
The waste-operation code R3+ must not be confused with the project's R3 Reuse strategy; evidence must resolve whether outputs qualify as recycling, energy recovery or neither.
A treatment input becomes circular evidence only after output mass, destination, nutrient content and realized use are established.
The all-waste export amount needs material- and facility-level destination evidence before treatment outcomes can be inferred.
The 19,132, 19,131 and 19,105 tonne figures must be reconciled, and any food-waste subset and destination treatment must be separately established.
An input-minus-harvest balance is not a destination account; actual nutrient return and loss destinations require separate measurements.
Neither a balance nor a rounded zero demonstrates realized resource circularity; outcome evidence requires recovered nutrient quantities and use.
Whole-country and Åland per-hectare rates cannot be subtracted; area-weighted numerators, denominators and a method bridge are needed for any mainland-Finland derivation.
The national total needs complete commodity children, including currently missing or false-zero sectors, before commodity completeness can be assessed.
The generation estimate does not establish treatment destinations, cascading use or final disposal.
Food-waste generation is not itself a circularity outcome; realized avoided loss, recovery and resource return need separate evidence.
Stage-specific survey frames, nonresponse, substitutions, Reykjavík-to-national extrapolation and uncertainty must be appraised before comparative use.
The marked false zero must remain unknown until direct or defensibly estimated aquaculture food-waste evidence is obtained.

appraisalDrafts.authorityAssessment: Eurostat is the EU statistical authority and the captured JSON-stat payload is an official dissemination dataset; institutional authority does not remove country-method or geography-boundary uncertainty.
appraisalDrafts.scopeFitAssessment: Strong fit for the selected EU food-waste reporting category and five named stage rows in Denmark; the FI portion is captured only as boundary-unresolved and supplies no admitted measurement.
appraisalDrafts.methodAssessment: Values were fetched through an exact reproducible API query for annual collected W091_092_101_FD waste in tonnes. National methods permitted under the framework can differ and the intake has not captured the full quality report.
appraisalDrafts.limitationAssessment: The account is not a complete side-stream, nutrient-flow or destination mass balance. The FI label does not resolve the separate Finland–Åland boundary and cannot support mainland-Finland inference.

appraisalDrafts.authorityAssessment: Luke is Finland's official natural-resources research institute and publishes the captured PxWeb dataset; the payload itself marks the table as not official statistics, so authority and statistical status must remain distinct.
appraisalDrafts.scopeFitAssessment: Direct fit for 2024 agricultural nitrogen and phosphorus balance rates for whole-country Finland and the separately reported Åland region; it does not measure nutrient pollution, recovered material or circular use.
appraisalDrafts.methodAssessment: The dataset defines balance as nutrient inputs minus harvested output. National balances include additional terms absent from regional calculations, and Åland is included nationally while separately reported regionally.
appraisalDrafts.limitationAssessment: National and Åland per-hectare rates are non-additive and cannot yield mainland Finland by subtraction. The Åland phosphorus value 0.0 is rounded and cannot prove absence.

appraisalDrafts.limitationAssessment: An internal 43,132 versus 43,152 tonne contradiction remains open. The 1.8 percent has its own exact Table 2 denominator locator and should not be generalized beyond the source-defined production basis.

appraisalDrafts.authorityAssessment: ÅSUB is Åland's official statistics and research bureau and publishes the captured waste-statistics report; official provenance does not resolve internal inconsistencies or outcome semantics.
appraisalDrafts.scopeFitAssessment: Provides Åland-only context for animal and mixed food waste, local R3+ treatment inputs and all-waste exports. The export figures are not food-waste-only, and R3+ is not proof of closed-loop recovery.
